question: 65% of 65 is how much more than (3)/(5) of 55.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First value = 65% of 65 = 42.25 (since 65² = 4225)

Second value = 3/5 of 55 = 3 × 11 = 33

Difference = 42.25 − 33 = 9.25

**∴ The correct answer is 9.25.**
